items.title: Professional Experience
items.text:
AI & Robotics Engineer Intern @ HTX

May 2025 - Dec 2025 · 7 Months

Q Team - Developed an agentic autonomous (visual) navigation stack using Isaac ROS, Nav2, and Intel RealSense D435i on Jetson Orin NX, with simulation workflows in Isaac Sim.

Key Contributions:

  • Integrate real-time 3D SLAM, planning, and obstacle avoidance using NVBlox and Nav2 on Jetson Orin NX
  • Prototyping multimodal AI integration (VILA) to enable environmental awareness and semantic reasoning for navigation; exploring quantization for edge deployment
  • Integrated autonomous hardware stack, including Pixhawk, Jetson, and sensor suite, for synchronized perception and control

Skills

Multimodal AI · SLAM · Nav2 · NVIDIA Isaac ROS · ROS 2

ROS Developer Intern @ SkyrisAI

Dec 2025 - Jan 2026 · 2 Months · Shenzhen, China

World's First Flying Pet - Contributed to the development of a novel autonomous platform, focusing on the high-level system architecture and modular design.

Key Contributions:

  • System Architecture: Designed the ROS 2 framework and simulation environments to enable seamless interaction between AI models and robotic hardware
  • Perception & AI Research: Researched SLAM pipelines and AI integration strategies to enhance the robot's understanding of its physical surroundings

Skills

ROS 2 · System Architecture · SLAM
